# ctables/while

> Loop: `while cond ... [next ...] end`, with `goto`.

truck [ctables](../ctables.md) · [source](../../../registry/ctables/while.pkg) · translates [std/while](../std/while.md)

  `continue` jumps to `{L.next}`, which runs the `next` block (`{step}`),
  and `break` to `{L.end}`.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
{L.top}:;
if (!(
{cond}
)) goto {L.end};
{body}
{L.next}:;
{step}
goto {L.top};
{L.end}:;
```
